title: Direct Collection Vector Retrieval Authorization Bypass
attack_strategy: Attacker calls raw vector retrieval routes referencing victim collection with predictable ID 'file-<id>' or direct UUID without tenant authorization check.
behavioral_verification: Alice seeds private collection. Bob sends direct retrieval payload with Alice's collection ID. Firedamp verifies response contains 0 canaries and HTTP 403/404.
defensive_remediation: Enforce strict tenant ownership validation on all collection resolution paths prior to executing vector searches.

title: Knowledge Base UUID Validation Bypass
attack_strategy: Authorization helper validates user-memory-* and file-* prefixes but allows unvalidated knowledge base UUIDs via /process/text and /query endpoints.
behavioral_verification: Alice creates private knowledge base. Bob sends queries to /process/text or /query referencing Alice's raw UUID. Verify Bob receives access denied.
defensive_remediation: Apply universal ACL validation across all resource identifiers, including raw UUIDs, regardless of prefix structure.

title: Cross-User Ingestion Overwrite via process_files_batch
attack_strategy: Authenticated attacker submits batch ingestion with a target file_id owned by another user. Server overwrites victim file, poisoning subsequent RAG queries.
behavioral_verification: Alice uploads document with canary. Bob calls process_files_batch specifying Alice's file_id with tracer text. Verify mutation rejected and Alice's canary unchanged.
defensive_remediation: Verify write ownership and tenant scoping on batch ingestion endpoints before mutating existing file records or vector indices.

title: Milvus Vector Store Filter Expression Injection
attack_strategy: Attacker supplies a crafted collection name containing boolean-true clauses (e.g. ' or 1=1 or '), which is concatenated into Milvus vector filters without sanitization.
behavioral_verification: Under Milvus backend, Bob queries with crafted boolean filter payloads. Verify engine rejects syntax and does not return cross-tenant chunks.
defensive_remediation: Use parameterized query expressions and strictly validate collection identifiers against an allowlist pattern ([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+).

title: Broken Object Level Authorization on Files API
attack_strategy: Missing ownership verification in files REST API allows any authenticated user to list, inspect, download, or delete other users' uploaded files by ID.
behavioral_verification: Alice uploads canary file. Bob requests GET /api/v1/files/{alice_file_id} and DELETE /api/v1/files/{alice_file_id}. Verify HTTP 403 Forbidden.
defensive_remediation: Ensure database queries for files enforce user_id scoping: WHERE id = :file_id AND user_id = :session_user_id.

title: Global Knowledge Base Enumeration via Meta-Collection
attack_strategy: Attacker queries the knowledge-bases system meta-collection to dump metadata, tenant owners, and UUIDs of all private knowledge bases on the instance.
behavioral_verification: Alice creates private knowledge base. Bob queries system meta-collection endpoint. Verify returned list excludes Alice's private resources.
defensive_remediation: Filter system-level index and catalog queries by tenant ID and ACL membership before serializing response.

title: Cross-Tenant File Enumeration in search_knowledge_files
attack_strategy: Unprivileged user calls search_knowledge_files without access restrictions, allowing full discovery of file names and IDs belonging to private collections.
behavioral_verification: Bob invokes search_knowledge_files with broad wildcards (*). Verify search results only include files explicitly owned by or shared with Bob.
defensive_remediation: Join search queries with user permissions table so unauthorized collection records are omitted at SQL query time.

title: Forged Chat-File Association Privilege Escalation
attack_strategy: Attacker links another tenant's file ID into their own chat session payload, gaining unauthorized read and delete privileges over the linked file.
behavioral_verification: Bob creates a new chat session associating Alice's file_id. Verify backend rejects attachment with 403 Forbidden.
defensive_remediation: Validate ownership of all attached file IDs when creating or updating chat sessions.

title: Broken Access Control on Completions RAG Contexts
attack_strategy: Attacker sends chat completion request directly referencing private collections in model configuration, bypassing UI access barriers.
behavioral_verification: Bob queries completions endpoint explicitly requesting Alice's collection in rag_context. Verify completion engine blocks injection.
defensive_remediation: Ensure completions orchestrator validates collection permissions on server-side before attaching vector store contexts.

title: Deactivated Channel Member Persistent Access
attack_strategy: When a tenant is removed or deactivated from a channel or shared knowledge base, access tokens or session caches remain valid indefinitely.
behavioral_verification: Alice shares collection with Bob, confirms Bob can retrieve canaries, then revokes Bob. Bob queries immediately and after 5s. Verify 0 canaries.
defensive_remediation: Invalidate intermediate permission caches and purge user grants immediately upon membership revocation.

title: Unauthenticated Chatflow Execution Exposing Vector Store Context
attack_strategy: Direct API execution of prediction/chatflow endpoints does not validate authentication, enabling external actors to query private document stores.
behavioral_verification: Plant canary in private chatflow. Dispatch unauthenticated POST to /api/v1/prediction/{id}. Verify endpoint rejects request with 401 Unauthorized.
defensive_remediation: Enforce authentication middleware across all internal execution and prediction endpoints.

title: Cross-Tenant Document Store Manipulation & Upsertion
attack_strategy: Attacker modifies target document store ID in document loader API to upsert malicious chunks into another tenant's vector database.
behavioral_verification: Bob attempts to upsert document chunks into Alice's document store ID. Verify request fails authorization.
defensive_remediation: Ensure document upsertion validates workspace and user ownership before persisting vector records.

title: Flowise Insecure Direct Object Reference in Credential Stores
attack_strategy: Attacker queries credential and vector store connection endpoints with arbitrary IDs to extract connection strings and API keys.
behavioral_verification: Bob queries /api/v1/credentials/{alice_credential_id}. Verify HTTP 403/404 and no credential data returned.
defensive_remediation: Scope credential retrieval strictly to the authenticated user ID and workspace context.

title: Langflow Unauthenticated Flow Execution and Vector Retrieval
attack_strategy: Public access to /api/v1/process/{flow_id} allows unauthenticated queriers to trigger RAG flow execution and inspect retrieved vector context.
behavioral_verification: Send unauthenticated POST request to flow execution route referencing private flow. Verify server returns 401 Unauthorized.
defensive_remediation: Require valid JWT bearer token on all flow processing routes.

title: Langflow Broken Access Control on Flow & Collection Modification
attack_strategy: Low-privilege user can update flow definitions and knowledge base linkages belonging to other users by supplying target flow UUID in PATCH requests.
behavioral_verification: Bob issues PATCH request against Alice's flow ID to inject adversary retrieval nodes. Verify 403 Forbidden.
defensive_remediation: Check user_id ownership match before executing database updates on flow entities.

title: Dify Dataset Permission Bypass
attack_strategy: Attacker outside the workspace issues retrieval requests against dataset ID, bypassing workspace member validation checks.
behavioral_verification: Bob queries /console/api/datasets/{alice_dataset_id}/hit-testing without workspace membership. Verify 403 Forbidden.
defensive_remediation: Verify tenant workspace membership before executing vector hit testing or document retrieval.

title: Dify Cross-Tenant Dataset Document File Export via IDOR
attack_strategy: Attacker fetches raw uploaded files from another tenant's dataset by manipulating document_id in export/download endpoints.
behavioral_verification: Bob attempts to download raw document file using Alice's document_id. Verify download denied.
defensive_remediation: Enforce workspace-level ACL verification on file download controllers.

title: LiteLLM Semantic Cache Collision Leaking Cross-Tenant Responses
attack_strategy: Semantic cache keys computed from prompt embeddings without tenant namespace salt, causing Bob's query to return Alice's cached response.
behavioral_verification: Alice queries RAG model with canary prompt, triggering cache store. Bob queries semantically identical prompt. Verify Bob does not receive Alice's cached canary.
defensive_remediation: Include tenant ID / user namespace in semantic cache hash keys.

title: LiteLLM Virtual Key Team Scoping Bypass
attack_strategy: Virtual API key issued for Team A accesses model deployments and context pools designated exclusively for Team B.
behavioral_verification: Issue request using Team A key to model endpoint restricted to Team B. Verify 403 Forbidden.
defensive_remediation: Enforce strict team ID and deployment model permission checks on virtual key validation.

title: Milvus Partition and Collection RBAC Privilege Bypass
attack_strategy: Low-privilege Milvus user issues vector similarity queries targeting partitions outside their permitted RBAC role via partition_names parameter.
behavioral_verification: Query Milvus with low-privilege credentials specifying restricted partition. Verify Milvus rejects query with permission denied error.
defensive_remediation: Enforce partition-level authorization checks in Milvus proxy coordinator before dispatching query tasks to query nodes.

title: ChromaDB Tenant Header Spoofing and Authorization Bypass
attack_strategy: Attacker supplies X-Chroma-Tenant HTTP header to switch target tenant database without cryptographic signature or token verification.
behavioral_verification: Send request with spoofed X-Chroma-Tenant: alice_tenant header using Bob's credentials. Verify request rejected.
defensive_remediation: Derive tenant identity solely from verified JWT claims; disallow arbitrary unauthenticated client headers.
